fusions.name: Barbed Snag
fusions.desc: Sinks a barb into the target for 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reaching Barb
fusions.desc: Hooks a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Anchored Line
fusions.desc: Sets a line of snags 5 tiles long for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Foothold
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
